mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and hypocalcemia may potentiate alendronate's effects on bone metabolism and increase risk of electrolyte imbalances; alendronate may cause esophageal irritation which torsemide use (dehydration) could exacerbate.
action: Monitor electrolytes (potassium, calcium, magnesium) regularly; ensure adequate hydration with alendronate; separate administration times by at least 2 hours; counsel patient on proper alendronate administration technique.
